description: Keep a rule the team agreed on ("sentence case in every button", "the brand gray stays, do not raise contrast bugs on it") in the project's context, under Rules learned. The classifier reads that context, and every agent reads it through decision_log, so it shapes future threads. Cite the threads it came from.
